leadText:
Matthew (Japanese: マシュー Matthew) is a character of the day who appeared in Luxray Vision!.

Matthew is the owner of a strange manor with hidden traps and tunnels. He had hired to help protect the Old Charm from The Bandit Beauties Three after receiving a threatening letter from them. Eventually, he also enlisted the help of and after they stumbled upon his mansion.
